meta.name: customize
meta.description: Add new capabilities or modify NanoClaw behavior. Use when user wants to add channels (Telegram, Slack, email input), change triggers, add integrations, modify the router, or make any other customizations. This is an interactive skill that asks questions to understand what the user wants.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扩展 NanoClaw,接入新渠道、调整触发与路由。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想按需扩展 NanoClaw 的功能和连接。
copy.tagline_en: Extend NanoClaw with new channels, triggers, and integrations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to customize NanoClaw's behavior and add new capabilities.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先用提问弄清你的需求,再对 NanoClaw 做定制:接入新输入渠道、新增 MCP 集成、修改触发规则或路由,并告诉你如何验证、如何重建重启。
howto.when: 当你想给 NanoClaw 添加渠道(Telegram、Slack 等)、新增集成,或修改触发规则与路由时接管;它会先提问确认你的需求。

say.text: 帮我给 NanoClaw 加一个 Telegram 输入渠道
say.note: 它会先问你接到哪个 agent group

say.text: 给这个 agent group 加上 Gmail 的 MCP 工具
say.note: 有对应技能就跑,否则写进容器配置

say.text: 把这条 wiring 的触发规则改一下
say.note: 用 ncl wirings update 生效

howto.what_en: After install, Claude first asks questions to understand your goal, then customizes NanoClaw: adding input channels, MCP integrations, or changing triggers and routing, and tells you how to verify and restart.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to add channels (Telegram, Slack, email), add integrations, change triggers, or modify the router. It asks clarifying questions first.

say_en.text: Add a Telegram input channel to NanoClaw
say_en.note: It asks which agent group it should reach

say_en.text: Add the Gmail MCP tool to this agent group
say_en.note: Runs the matching skill, else edits container config

say_en.text: Change the trigger rules on this wiring
